summary: Iteration 25 — Frontend-only testing of three new feature sets on /songcoder.html: (1) image viewer with pinch/double-tap/wheel/+-/drag/swipe/esc/backdrop, (2) admin 'Preview as Icon' read-only mode, (3) Release countdown badges (compose, catalog, projects, PR rows). Admin passcode login + mock-chelly icon regression also verified. Most functionality works; TWO viewer bugs found: (a) tapping the artist-card photo (.ph) does NOT open the viewer though the spec lists 'the artist photo' as a tap target, (b) a single backdrop tap does NOT close the viewer — swipe-down/Esc/X all close as expected but a quick backdrop click is swallowed because the pointerup close branch gates on 'Date.now() - lastTap > 250' while lastTap was just set to now in the same pointerdown.

ui_bugs.issue: Single tap on empty backdrop area does not close the viewer. pointerup close condition `start.px != null && !start.moved && s === 1 && e.target === lb && Date.now() - lastTap > 250` fails because `lastTap = now` was set in the matching pointerdown — the diff is always ~0ms, so the close line is unreachable on a fresh single tap. Esc / × / swipe-down still close correctly.

Tapping the circular artist photo (.artist-card .ph) does NOT open the image viewer. The .ph div has no data-zoom-bg attribute and is not an , so the capture click handler skips it. Spec lists 'the artist photo' alongside artist-card-banner as a tap target.

action_items: ImageViewer: fix backdrop close. Either drop the `Date.now() - lastTap > 250` guard on the pointerup single-tap close branch, or compare against `start.t` (the pointerdown time) rather than `lastTap`. Suggested: in pointerdown save `start.t = now` and in pointerup use `Date.now() - start.t < 250` as a 'short tap' test; close when target is the lb and the tap was short and didn't move.

Add data-zoom-bg to .artist-card .ph (and emit the photo URL via its background-image) so single-tapping the artist photo opens the viewer. Alternatively render an inside .ph since the capture handler already picks up img elements inside main/.drawer/.modal.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html:4678 — `if (start && start.px != null && !start.moved && s === 1 && e.target === lb && Date.now() - lastTap > 250) close();` — the time guard references `lastTap` which is overwritten to `now` inside the matching pointerdown (line 4664), so this close path can never fire on a single tap. Should reference pointerdown time instead of lastTap.
songcoder.html:2560 — artist card markup gives .bg a data-zoom-bg but omits it on .ph. Add data-zoom-bg to .ph so the capture handler on line 4687 picks it up for photo taps, matching the spec.

songcoder.html:4687 — The handler covers main .song .cv img (catalog cover), any main/.drawer/.modal (icons/blog/review/scan/compose preview cover), and [data-zoom-bg] (artist-card-banner). Project cards don't match because .song.proj-card uses div.cv (no img inside unless cover present) — verified no viewer opens from project cards. Dropzones (.drop) are correctly ZOOM_SKIPped. Good coverage overall.

songcoder.html:4705 — pickPreviewIcon() correctly gates on isAdmin(); state.realAuth saved and restored by exitPreview; previewBlock() toasts 'Preview mode is read-only…' and short-circuits write paths; good read-only pattern.

songcoder.html:4701 dropBadge + 5313 setInterval(1s) correctly re-paints every [data-countdown] element; shortLeft() handles d/h/m/s rollover; isUpcoming() prevents past dates from rendering badges. Verified ticking at 1s cadence in compose preview.

rca of the issue: (1) Backdrop single-tap close is unreachable because the gate `Date.now() - lastTap > 250` uses lastTap that was just overwritten in the current pointerdown (line 4664), so the diff is always close to 0ms, failing the >250 check. Likely intended guard was 'don't close in the middle of a double-tap sequence', which should instead compare pointerdown time with the previous lastTap value (save `prevTap = lastTap` before writing `lastTap = now`, then check `now - prevTap > 300`). (2) Artist photo .ph lacks data-zoom-bg and isn't an , so neither of the three branches in the capture handler on line 4687 matches it. Spec explicitly includes 'the artist photo' as a viewer trigger. Fix: add `data-zoom-bg` attribute to the .ph div in the roster template at line 2560 (next to the existing data-zoom-bg on .bg).
